item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 18/Apr/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The trough of low pressure currently over central China will move closer to the coast of southern China gradually, and will bring showers and squally thunderstorms to the region in the next couple of days. With the trough of low pressure weakening, showers will ease off and the weather will improve slightly over the coast of Guangdong during the weekend and early next week. A surge of the northeast monsoon is expected to affect the coast of Guangdong midweek next week.
